params.caption: 🎮 Binding of Isaac picks a fight with GTA 6 on release day The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ online update lands on consoles on November 19, the very same day as GTA 6. Creator Edmund McMillen admits launch timing matters, after Mewgenics' hot streak was cooled by Slay the Spire 2, but jokes: "If it was a stupid idea, it's a funny stupid idea." 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 01:45 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: GamesRadar+ · Engadget 😈 Isaac or Vice City on Nov 19?
